# The Bachelors FC

> The Bachelors FC is an apolitical, non-profit football club in Khulshi, Chittagong, Bangladesh, for bachelor youth. Founded in 2026. Motto: "Forged in Brotherhood, Driven by Purpose" — also "United, Not Alone". The club has no sponsors and no stadium; it is run entirely by its members.

## Key facts

- Location: Khulshi, Chittagong, Bangladesh
- Founded: 2026
- Founder: Saidul Mostafa Chowdhury
- Members: 16 total, 12 active squad players
- Grounds: Stadium X, Diesel Colony Play Ground, Jhautala Playground, Shahid Sahjahan Field
- Ethos: match outcomes are celebrated without publishing scorelines, out of respect for opponents
